core_meaning.primary_meaning: Gabr is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Restoration, compulsion, setting (of a bone)”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Gabr corresponds to the Arabic form جَبْر (Arabic root ج ب ر (j-b-r); جَبْر (jabr)). Its core sense is compeller, one who helps the broken. Gabr corresponds to the Arabic word جَبْر (jabr) 'restoration, compulsion, setting (of a bone)', from the root ج ب ر (j-b-r). The source gloss 'mountain' is wrong (that is جبل jabal) and has been replaced. It is used as a given name, though less commonly than the derived Jābir (gabir).

persian.name: جبر
